strict=False; return_report=False; from_naming_scheme=None; no extra kwargs

Selections/reports/naming/options/composites/other targets and legacy versions retain their existing routes.
No new scientific method, optional engine or public argument is added.

documentation.scope: HTML compilation and rendered contract inspection without notebook execution.

Six HTML title warnings match the retained prior build.
